intro: Thousands of islands of bold, spicy, sweet-soy cooking: rendang, satay, fried rice and sambal with everything.
flavours: Sambal, kecap manis (sweet soy), coconut, shallots, galangal, turmeric
hk: Causeway Bay's Indonesian shops and stalls near Victoria Park come alive on Sundays.

dishes.name: Nasi goreng
dishes.what: Fried rice seasoned with sweet soy and shrimp paste, topped with a fried egg and prawn crackers.

dishes.name: Rendang
dishes.what: Dark, dry, intensely spiced beef in reduced coconut milk; from West Sumatra.

dishes.name: Sate ayam
dishes.what: Chicken skewers grilled over charcoal with sweet peanut sauce and kecap manis.

dishes.name: Gado-gado
dishes.what: Salad of blanched vegetables, tofu, tempeh and egg under peanut sauce.

dishes.name: Bakso
dishes.what: Bouncy beef meatballs in a clear broth with noodles.

dishes.name: Soto ayam
dishes.what: Turmeric-yellow chicken soup with vermicelli, egg and lime.

dishes.name: Babi guling
dishes.what: Balinese spit-roasted suckling pig stuffed with spice paste.

dishes.name: Martabak manis
dishes.what: Thick, sweet folded pancake filled with chocolate, cheese and peanuts.
